parts.title: Listening - Part 1 (Picture Multiple Choice)
parts.instructions: For each question, choose the correct answer (A, B, or C).

What sport does the boy want to do?
What is the girl going to buy?

parts.title: Listening - Part 3 (Conversation Multiple Choice)
parts.instructions: For each question, choose the correct answer.

questions.question: Where did Jonathan spend his holiday?
When did they leave?
What does Quentin say about Yellowstone Park?

options.B: It’s America’s most exciting national park.

questions.question: What was he afraid of at the campsite?
What is Quentin unhappy about?

options.A: He spent too much on souvenirs.

parts.title: Listening - Part 4 (Short Extracts Multiple Choice)
parts.instructions: For each question, choose the correct answer.

questions.question: You will hear a boy and a girl talking about an evening at the cinema. Why did the boy leave?
You will hear two friends talking about a basketball match. Why was the girl unhappy about it?

options.B: One of the players got hurt.

questions.question: You will hear two friends talking about a book they’ve read. They agree that.
You will hear two friends talking about a computer game. The girl is talking to the boy about it because

options.A: she would like to borrow something.
options.B: she wants to ask him something.

questions.question: You will hear two friends talking about afternoon lessons. What is the boy learning to do?
